title: Lovely Malty Beer

sources.title: Alcohol (surface)
markers: | summary = a type of [[surface]] created by throwing or otherwise breaking a container of alcohol. It can be ignited or frozen.

summary: Contributes 1 Camp Supply toward Long Rest or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol gives disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent 13 ft radius Alcohol surface that can ignite or freeze.
fields.Base value: 2 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Camp supplies: Provides 1 Camp Supply for a Long Rest.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
